lines.en: Snow spins in the gaps of my bones.
The frozen ground creaks underfoot.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我留下的脚印很快就没了。
lines.en: My tracks vanish fast in snow.
I walk slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 雪坡上的风，把我的皮吹硬了。
lines.en: Slope wind hardened my hide.
Snow covers my tracks and I lose my way.

lines.zh: 冻得腿硬，我已经很快了。
lines.en: Frozen legs, and I am already fast.

lines.zh: 关节里的冰又开始响了。
lines.en: The ice in my joints is rattling again.

lines.zh: 这双腿冻得像两根木头。
lines.en: These legs are frozen stiff as two logs.
That little firelight ahead — it is alive.
The smell of rotten flesh, under the snow.
The wind blows through and my bones rattle.
I counted to the seventh rib.
Snow settles in my eye sockets and will not melt.

lines.zh: 站着不动，雪就爬上来了。
lines.en: Stand still, and the snow climbs over me.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气，一点白都没有。
lines.en: Not a wisp of white leaves my breath.
The iron ingot in my pocket sticks to my hand.
This body has forgotten how to be warm.

lines.zh: 雪原静得能听见骨头响。
lines.en: The snowfield is quiet enough to hear my bones.
I think I forgot how to sit down.
The rotten flesh is frozen solid, too hard to chew.
Snowballs drop from my rotten flesh.
Your warmth steams off the snow.

lines.zh: 活人走路的姿势，真陌生。
lines.en: The way the living walk — so strange to me.
Your eyes still move. Good.

lines.zh: 雪球在我兜里，一直没化。
lines.en: Snowballs in my pocket never melted.
There is iron on your scent.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我的皮比雪还白。
lines.en: On the snowfield my skin is whiter than snow.

lines.zh: 雪地上，你的热气太明显。
lines.en: On the snow your warmth is too obvious.

lines.zh: 你认识我吗，雪把脸盖住了。
lines.en: Do you know me? Snow covers my face.
The snow glare hides you from me.
Snow clumps on my lashes.
Frozen stiff, and still standing.
The snowball in my hand has not melted.
The ice crust cracked. That hurts.
Hit me? This body does not mind pain.
Snowballs roll off me.

lines.zh: 雪地里我的关节咔咔响。
lines.en: My joints creak in the snowfield.

lines.zh: 雪球从我怀里滚出去了。
lines.en: A snowball rolled out of my arms.
Frozen arms won't lift.

lines.zh: 身上挂着的雪球，还没化。
lines.en: The snowballs on me haven't melted.
Clack, my frozen joints are creaking.
That meat is still warm, the snow is melting.
That smell melts the snow around it.
Iron? I have a use for it.
My teeth are frozen shut.
Leave me one piece. Do not take it all.
Frozen hands can't grip.

lines.zh: 你手上那铁锭，我看着呢。
lines.en: That iron ingot in your hand; I see it.
My teeth are frozen. Feed me slowly.

lines.zh: 雪地里，这味道不该出现。
lines.en: On the snow, that smell should not be here.
Snow is packed under my nails.
Bump me and your arm hurts first.
My shoulder is harder than ice.
Who is shoving me? Get back.
Bone against bone — such a crisp sound.
Stop pushing. I cannot stand steady in snow.
The snowballs I carry are still frozen.
You stepped on my foot, living one.
Easy — this body cracks.
You knocked the snow off me. And bits of me.

lines.zh: 冰雪塞进关节，走一步响一下。
lines.en: Ice in my joints clicks with every step.

lines.zh: 我这几根骨头，还能抱人。
lines.en: Even these bones can still hold someone.

lines.zh: 雪底下，我给你留了位置。
lines.en: Under the snow I saved you a place.

lines.zh: 别嫌我冷，我不会更冷了。
lines.en: Do not mind the cold. I cannot get colder.

lines.zh: 活着没说完的话，现在说。
lines.en: Words I never said alive — I say them now.

lines.zh: 月亮照着我们两个影子。
lines.en: The moon lights both our shadows.
Frost has formed on my skin.
You are warm. I will remember this temperature.
I will not leave. The snow will melt first.
Snow on my shoulder does not melt.
Grave snow can serve as a wedding veil.
My fingers froze into one block.
This iron has been buried a long while.
Pick up a snowball, and my hand grows colder.
Fingers frozen. Can't pick it up.
Anything that glints cold is mine.
The rotten flesh is mine. Do not fight me.
Stuff it in my coat. It freezes there.
Out on the snowfield, anything is worth picking up.
I will carry it back and lay it on the grave.
My fingers will not bend to hold it.
You cracked the ice beneath my feet.
You are the only living thing on this snowfield.
I still clutch a snowball.
I smell blood. Warm blood.
Stop running. I know these paths better.

lines.zh: 我看着你，关节都不响了。
lines.en: I am watching you; my joints have gone quiet.
The prey has stopped. Good.

lines.zh: 雪原上的生者，站住别动。
lines.en: Living one on the snowfield — hold still.

lines.zh: 雪会记住你倒下的位置。
lines.en: The snow will remember where you fall.
Don't fear — I strike fast.
I have locked on. You will not get far.
Turn around. Let me see you.

lines.zh: 寒夜里，你是我唯一的暖。
lines.en: In this cold night, you are my only warmth.

lines.zh: 雪球砸在我脸上，慢慢来。
lines.en: A snowball to my face; take it slow.
In the snow, my steps are heavy.
The more you run, the deeper the snow.
Look back at me.
Your shadow follows you. So do I.

lines.zh: 脚印一深一浅，你跟不上。
lines.en: One deep print, one shallow — you cannot keep up.
I need no breath. You do.
The snowfield ends in a dead end.

lines.zh: 雪地上我的脚印是黑的。
lines.en: My footprints stain the snow dark.

lines.zh: 我掉的雪球，比腐肉还多。
lines.en: I drop more snowballs than rotten flesh.
Snow crunches — three steps left.
The frozen ground will trip your feet.
Ten steps left. I am counting.
Do not run uphill. The wind bites there.
My joints are creaking. Do not look back.
The snow's knee-deep and I'm slow.
The snowfield has no end. Only me.

lines.zh: 冰原上，我的关节都冻住了。
lines.en: On the icefield, my joints freeze.

lines.zh: 雪原这片地，我闭眼都认得。
lines.en: I know this snowfield blindfolded.

lines.zh: 冻土上追你，你已经输了。
lines.en: Chased across frozen ground, you've lost.

lines.zh: 这具冻僵的身体，就这点用。
lines.en: This frozen body is good for only this.
This blow comes with ice shards.
My finger bones are harder than a blade.
Touch you, and your skin will freeze to mine.
Does it hurt? I forgot pain long ago.
Cold to the bone — oddly clear-headed.
Fall, and the snow will cover you.
Do not dodge. I am slow, but I arrive.
This one carries the weight of iron.
My hands are split with frost. I still strike.
My hands are frozen slick — sorry.
The ice crust on me falls off at a touch.
That crack — that is your bone.
Closer. Let me get my teeth in.
I swing slow. Do not fall too soon.
On the snowfield there is nowhere left to step.
The snowbank splits and I crawl out.
Under the ice, I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 又是这片雪，又是这身骨头。
lines.en: This snow again. These bones again.
I crawl out of the snowbank.
I push myself up out of the frozen soil.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气，一点都不白。
lines.en: My breath does not fog at all.
One cold gust and I am awake.
Someone lit a fire on the snowfield.
This frozen body again.

lines.zh: 积雪针叶林里，我一瘸一拐。
lines.en: In the snowy taiga, I limp along.

lines.zh: 这副旧身子，又站起来了。
lines.en: This old body stands up once more.
The snow pressed me down all winter.
My fingers move. Which one first?
The sky is still dark and I am awake.

lines.zh: 别用火！我身上的冰会化。
lines.en: Not fire! The ice on me will melt.
Falling on ice, harder than stone.
I don't breathe, yet it hurts.

lines.zh: 雪球掉在地上，碎成一片。
lines.en: The snowball hit the ground and scattered.

lines.zh: 箭头冻在我肩胛骨上了。
lines.en: The arrowhead froze into my shoulder blade.
The snowball melts too fast in my hand.

lines.zh: 冻肉啃不动，我得找点软的。
lines.en: Frozen flesh will not chew; I need something softer.

lines.zh: 雷落在雪上，我整具都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the snow and numbed all of me.
Not even snow down here.
